title: Free-Floating Subdivisions: Ethnic Groups
scope: Topical and form subdivisions usable on a free-floating basis under headings for ethnic groups (including preliterate groups, historic peoples, races, U.S. ethnic groups, Jews and Jews of various nationalities, Indigenous peoples of the Western Hemisphere and individual tribes) and under nationalities only when designating them outside their native countries
general_notes: LC practice: As stated in H 1075, LC catalogers will no longer use form subdivisions. Instead assign an appropriate term or terms from Library of Congress Genre/Form Terms (LCGFT), e.g. *Textbooks*. To replace a form subdivision that includes a demographic group, also assign Library of Congress Demographic Groups Terms (LCDGT) to bring out the audience of the resource being cataloged, e.g. *German speakers* or *Arabic, Students of*.

Nationalities: Do not subdivide headings for nationalities by subdivisions on this list to designate a topic in conjunction with a nationality in its own country. Instead, express the topic by headings of the type: *[topic]--[place]* or *[place]--[topic]*, for example, *Mental health--United States*, not Americans--Mental health; *Spain--Antiquities*, not Spanish--Antiquities. Subdivisions on this list may be used under headings for nationalities only to express topics in conjunction with those nationalities outside their native countries, for example, *Spanish--Florida--Antiquities*; *Turks--Employment--Germany*. For guidelines on the construction and use of headings for nationalities, see H 1919.5.

The category includes the heading Jews and headings for Jews of various nationalities, for example, *Jews, Italian*, except for subdivisions noted in the list below and indicated by UF references in the subject authority file.

This list does not cover the general headings Indigenous peoples and Tribes, nor the jurisdictional name headings established to represent the governments of tribes recognized by the United States government, for example, *Spokane Tribe of the Spokane Reservation, Washington*. Classes of persons qualified by ethnic or national adjectives (e.g. *African American dentists*) are covered by H 1100.
Cross-references printed in the list (May Subd Geog column "--") are not valid subdivisions; they are kept separately in see_references with their targets (or the instruction to follow).
